title: Incidence Theory: Lean 4 Formalization of Bisimulation, Quotients, and Ternary Resonance
description: A Lean 4 development of incidence structures with an independent, possibly multi-valued ternary resonance relation. The checked research package proves the exact-descent congruence criterion for incidence-bisimulation quotients, uniqueness and categorical universal properties, finite coordinatewise obstruction classification, a structural classification of 32 support-minimal simplex obstruction orbits, graded simplicial quotient families, free and equational presentations, and scoped positive and negative models. The record makes no claim of a fourth foundation, full ZF or HoTT interpretation, or priority over general quotient and coalgebraic theory.
